segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## 무엇이 달러를 움직이는가?

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: 환율은 다른 통화 대비 한 통화의 상대적인 매력을 반영합니다.

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 요인이 가장 중요하게 작용하는 경향이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **금리 전망.** 투자자들이 미국 금리가 다른 주요 경제국보다 높게 유지될 것으로 예상하면 달러 표시 자산이 더 매력적으로 변하며, 통화에 대한 수요가 증가할 수 있습니다. 격차가 좁혀지면 반대 현상이 일어날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **경제 성장 및 데이터.** 미국의 강력한 고용, 지출 및 인플레이션 수치는 중앙은행 정책에 대한 기대를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 어느 방향이든 예상치 못한 결과는 종종 가장 급격한 움직임을 유발합니다.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **안전 자산 수요.** 세계적인 불확실성 시기에 투자자들은 종종 미국 국채로 자금을 옮기는데, 이는 달러를 지지하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **무역 및 재정 정책.** 관세 발표, 무역 협상 및 정부 차입 계획은 모두 시간이 지남에 따라 투자자가 통화를 어떻게 보는지에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **타국의 정책.** 달러는 항상 다른 무언가와 비교하여 표시됩니다. 유럽중앙은행, 일본은행 또는 다른 곳의 정책 변화는 미국 상황이 변하지 않더라도 환율을 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: 단일 요인으로 한 해의 통화 움직임을 설명할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 종종 어떤 요인이 지배적인지에 대해 의견이 갈리며, 예측의 실적도 엇갈립니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## 여행자에게 의미하는 것

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: 해외로 여행하는 미국인에게 강달러는 일반적으로 더 높은 구매력을 의미합니다.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: 유로화나 엔화가 더 적은 달러로 교환되므로 식사, 숙박 및 기념품이 더 저렴하게 느껴질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: 약달러는 반대로 작용하여 같은 여행 비용을 상승시킵니다.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 팁:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **표시된 환율만 보지 말고 총비용을 비교하세요.** 카드 수수료, ATM 이용료 및 공항 환전소는 유리한 환율을 상쇄할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **현지 통화로 결제하세요.** 카드 단말기에서 달러로 결제할 것을 제안할 때, 적용되는 환율은 종종 불리합니다. 현지 통화를 선택하는 것이 보통 비용이 덜 듭니다.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **해외 결제 수수료가 없는 카드를 고려하세요.** 이러한 수수료는 일부 카드에서 보통 3퍼센트 정도 발생하며, 긴 여행 동안 합산되면 큰 금액이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **상황에 맞다면 고액 항목은 미리 결제하세요.** 호텔이나 투어 가격을 달러로 고정하면 환율 변동에 대한 불확실성을 제거할 수 있지만, 유연성은 줄어들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: 미국을 방문하는 여행객에게는 반대가 적용됩니다. 강달러는 미국 여행을 더 비싸게 만들어 관광 의존적인 기업과 목적지에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## 수출업체와 수입업체에게 의미하는 것

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: 강달러는 미국

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: 상품을 해외 구매자에게 더 비싸게 만들어, 기업이 가격을 낮추고 더 얇은 마진을 감수하지 않는 한 수출 판매에 부담을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: 약달러는 제품을 해외에서 더 저렴하게 만들어 수출업체를 돕는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: 수입업체는 정반대의 상황을 봅니다.

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: 강달러는 외국산 상품 및 자재 비용을 낮추어 수입에 의존하는 소매업체와 제조업체의 비용 부담을 덜어줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: 소비자는 때때로 낮은 가격을 통해 혜택을 보지만, 가격 전가는 고르지 않고 종종 지연됩니다.

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: 회계적인 영향도 있습니다.

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: 대규모 다국적 기업은 여러 통화로 수익을 올립니다.

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: 해외 수익을 달러로 환산할 때, 강달러는 보고된 총액을 줄이고 약달러는 이를 부풀립니다.

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: 기업들은 종종 실적 보고서에서 이를 "통화 역풍(currency headwind)" 또는 "순풍(tailwind)"으로 언급하며, 많은 기업이 그 영향을 완화하기 위해 헤지 계약을 사용합니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## 당신의 포트폴리오에 의미하는 것

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: 통화 움직임은 직장 은퇴 플랜의 광범위한 펀드를 포함하여 해외 투자를 보유한 모든 사람에게 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **해외 주식 및 채권.** 유로, 엔 또는 기타 통화로 표시된 자산을 보유하고 있다면, 달러 기준 가치는 자산의 성과와 환율 모두에 달려 있습니다. 달러 상승은 해외 보유 자산의 수익률을 감소시킬 수 있고, 달러 하락은 이를 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **미국 다국적 기업.** 수익의 상당 부분을 해외에서 올리는 기업은 위에서 설명한 대로 달러에 따라 이익이 변동할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **원자재.** 석유와 금을 포함한 많은 원자재는 달러로 가격이 책정됩니다. 강달러는 다른 통화를 사용하는 구매자에게 이들을 더 비싸게 만들 수 있으며 때때로 가격에 하방 압력을 가합니다.

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **헤지 펀드 대 비헤지 펀드.** 일부 펀드는 통화 영향을 줄이기 위해 계약을 사용합니다. 이러한 펀드는 비용이 더 많이 들 수 있고 비헤지 버전과 다르게 움직일 수 있으므로 펀드 설명을 읽어보는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: 통화 움직임은 또한 시간이 지남에 따라 반전되고 다시 반전되는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: 많은 장기 투자자는 다음 환율 변동을 예측하려고 하기보다는 다각화와 투자 기간에 집중합니다.

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: 보유 자산이 어떻게 노출되어 있는지 확실하지 않다면, 면허를 가진 재무 전문가의 도움을 받아 검토할 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: ## 승자와 패자 한눈에 보기

segments.tr: | | 강달러 | 약달러 |

segments.src: | Foreign visitors to the U.S. | Face higher costs | Gain buying power |

segments.tr: | 미국 수입업체 및 쇼핑객 | 종종 도움받음 | 종종 압박받음 |

segments.tr: | 미국 투자자가 보유한 해외 자산 | 수익 감소 가능성 | 수익 증가 가능성 |

segments.src: These are general tendencies, not guarantees.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 경향이며 보장이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Real-world outcomes depend on pricing power, contracts, hedging and timing.
segments.tr: 실제 결과는 가격 결정력, 계약, 헤지 및 시점에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The dollar's value is a moving piece in the economy that touches nearly everyone, whether or not they ever exchange a single bill.
segments.tr: 달러 가치는 단 한 번도 환전을 하지 않더라도 거의 모든 사람에게 영향을 미치는 경제의 움직이는 요소입니다.

segments.src: Travelers can protect their budgets by watching fees and exchange rates, businesses can plan around currency risk, and investors can understand how much of their portfolio depends on foreign currencies.
segments.tr: 여행자는 수수료와 환율을 주시하여 예산을 보호할 수 있고, 기업은 통화 위험을 고려하여 계획을 세울 수 있으며, 투자자는 자신의 포트폴리오 중 얼마가 외국 통화에 의존하는지 이해할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Staying informed, and keeping a long-term view, is usually more useful than reacting to each day's headline.
segments.tr: 매일의 헤드라인에 반응하는 것보다 정보를 계속 파악하고 장기적인 관점을 유지하는 것이 보통 더 유용합니다.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## 推动美元波动的因素是什么？

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: 汇率反映了一种货币相对于另一种货币的吸引力。

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: 少数几种力量往往起决定性作用：

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **利率预期。** 当投资者预计美国利率将持续高于其他主要经济体时，以美元计价的资产会更具吸引力，对美元的需求也可能上升。当利差缩小 时，情况可能刚好相反。

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **经济增长与数据。** 强劲的美国就业、消费和通胀数据可能会改变对央行政策的预期。无论是哪个方向的意外数据，往往都会引发最剧烈的波动。

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **避险需求。** 在全球不确定性时期，投资者往往会将资金转移到美国国债中，这通常会支撑美元。

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **贸易与财政政策。** 关税声明、贸易谈判和政府借贷计划都随着时间的推移影响投资者对该货币的看法。

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **其他国家的政策。** 美元总是相对于某种货币进行报价。即使美国国内情况保持不变，欧洲中央银行、日本银行或其他地方的政策转变也可能推动汇率变化。

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: 没有单一因素能完全解释一整年的货币走势。

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: 分析师往往对哪些因素占据主导地位持不同意见，而且预测的历史记录参差不齐。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## 对游客意味着什么

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: 对于赴海外旅游的美国人来说，美元走强通常意味着更高的购买力。

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: 兑换欧元或日元所需的美元更少，因此餐饮、住宿和纪念品感觉会更便宜。

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: 美元走弱则恰恰相反，会推高同一趟行程的成本。

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: 几条实用建议：

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **比较总成本，而不仅仅是表面汇率。** 刷卡费、ATM手续费和机场兑换点可能会吞噬有利的汇率。

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **使用当地货币支付。** 当刷卡终端建议以美元结算时，转换汇率通常不太划算。选择当地货币通常花费更少。

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **考虑使用无外币交易费的卡。** 这些费用在某些卡上通常占 3% 左右，在漫长的旅程中积少成多。

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **适时预付大额项目。** 用美元锁定酒店或行程价格可以避免汇率的不确定性，尽管这可能会降低灵活性。

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: 对于来美国的外国游客而言，情况刚好相反：美元走强使得赴美旅游成本更高，这可能会影响依赖旅游业的企业和目的地。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## 对出口商和进口商意味着什么

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: 美元走强使得美国

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: 产品对于外国买家来说更为昂贵，除非企业降价并接受更低的利润率，否则这会压抑出口销售。

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: 美元走弱往往有助于出口商，因为它使他们的产品在海外更加便宜。

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: 进口商面临的则是镜象情况。

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: 美元走强降低了外国制造的产品和原料的成本，这可以减轻依赖进口的零售商和制造商的成本压力。

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: 消费者有时会通过更低的价格受益，尽管传导过程往往不均匀且有延迟。

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: 此外还有会计效应。

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: 大型跨国公司以多种货币赚取收入。

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: 当这些海外收益折算回美元时，美元走强会缩减报告的总额，而美元走弱则会使其膨胀。

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: 公司经常在财报中将此称为“汇率逆风”或“顺风”，许多公司使用对冲合约来缓解这种影响。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## 对您的投资组合意味着什么

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: 对于拥有国际投资的人（包括工作场所退休计划中的广泛基金）来说，汇率波动都很重要。

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **国际股票和债券。** 如果您持有以欧元、日元或其他货币计价的资产，它们以美元计价的价值既取决于资产本身的表现，也取决于汇率。美元上涨可能会降低海外资产的回报，而美元下跌则可能会提升回报。

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **美国跨国公司。** 正如上文所述，大部分收入来自海外的公司，其利润可能会随美元波动而起伏。

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **大宗商品。** 包括石油和黄金在内的许多大宗商品均以美元计价。美元走强会导致使用其他货币的买家购买成本更高，有时会对价格产生下行压力。

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **对冲与非对冲基金。** 一些基金使用合约来减少货币效应。这些基金的成本可能更高，且表现可能与非对冲版本有所不同，因此值得仔细阅读基金的说明书。

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: 汇率走势随着时间的推移也往往会出现反复逆转。

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: 许多长期投资者专注于分散投资和自己的投资期限，而不是试图预测下一次汇率转变。

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: 如果您不确定自己的持仓面临怎样的风险敞口，持牌金融专业人士可以帮助您进行审阅。

segments.src: ## Winners and Losers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## 胜者与败者一览

segments.src: | | Stronger dollar | Weaker dollar |
segments.tr: | | 美元走强 | 美元走弱 |

segments.src: | U.S. travelers abroad | Gain buying power | Face higher costs |
segments.tr: | 海外出游的美国游客 | 获得购买力 | 面临更高成本 |

segments.src: | Foreign visitors to the U.S. | Face higher costs | Gain buying power |
segments.tr: | 赴美旅游的外国游客 | 面临更高成本 | 获得购买力 |

segments.src: | U.S. exporters | Often pressured | Often helped |
segments.tr: | 美国出口商 | 往往面临压力 | 往往获得助力 |

segments.src: | U.S. importers and shoppers | Often helped | Often pressured |
segments.tr: | 美国进口商及消费者 | 往往获得助力 | 往往面临压力 |

segments.src: | Foreign assets held by U.S. investors | Returns may shrink | Returns may grow |
segments.tr: | 美国投资者持有的海外资产 | 回报可能缩水 | 回报可能增加 |

segments.src: These are general tendencies, not guarantees.
segments.tr: 这些是总体趋势，并非绝对保证。

segments.src: Real-world outcomes depend on pricing power, contracts, hedging and timing.
segments.tr: 现实世界的结果取决于定价能力、合同、对冲和时机。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The dollar's value is a moving piece in the economy that touches nearly everyone, whether or not they ever exchange a single bill.
segments.tr: 美元的价值是经济中动态变化的一环，几乎影响着每个人，无论他们是否兑换过纸币。

segments.src: Travelers can protect their budgets by watching fees and exchange rates, businesses can plan around currency risk, and investors can understand how much of their portfolio depends on foreign currencies.
segments.tr: 游客可以通过关注费用和汇率来规划预算，企业可以围绕汇率风险进行规划，投资者可以了解自己的投资组合中有多少依赖于外币。

segments.src: Staying informed, and keeping a long-term view, is usually more useful than reacting to each day's headline.
segments.tr: 保持信息通畅并坚持长期视角，通常比对每天的头条新闻做出反应更为实用。

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## डॉलर में बदलाव क्यों आता है?

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: विनिमय दरें अन्य मुद्राओं की तुलना में किसी एक मुद्रा के सापेक्ष आकर्षण को दर्शाती हैं।

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: कुछ प्रमुख कारक सबसे अधिक मायने रखते हैं:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दर की उम्मीदें।** जब निवेशकों को उम्मीद होती है कि अमेरिकी ब्याज दरें अन्य प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाओं की तुलना में अधिक रहेंगी, तो डॉलर-मूल्यवर्ग की परिसंपत्तियाँ अधिक आकर्षक हो जाती हैं, और मुद्रा की मांग बढ़ सकती है। जब यह अंतर कम होता है, तो इसके विपरीत हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **आर्थिक वृद्धि और आंकड़े।** अमेरिका में मजबूत रोजगार, खर्च और मुद्रास्फीति के आंकड़े केंद्रीय बैंक की नीति के बारे में उम्मीदों को बदल सकते हैं। किसी भी दिशा में अप्रत्याशित बदलाव अक्सर सबसे तेज हलचल का कारण बनते हैं।

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **सुरक्षित-ठौर (Safe-haven) मांग।** वैश्विक अनिश्चितता के दौर में, निवेशकों ने अक्सर अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी (U.S. Treasuries) में पैसा लगाया है, जो डॉलर को समर्थन देता है।

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **व्यापार और राजकोषीय नीति।** टैरिफ की घोषणाएं, व्यापार वार्ताएं और सरकारी उधार योजनाएं सभी समय के साथ इस बात को प्रभावित कर सकती हैं कि निवेशक मुद्रा को कैसे देखते हैं।

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **अन्य देशों में नीतियां।** डॉलर की कीमत हमेशा किसी अन्य मुद्रा के मुकाबले तय की जाती है। यूरोपीय सेंट्रल बैंक, बैंक ऑफ जापान या अन्य जगहों पर नीति में बदलाव से विनिमय दर प्रभावित हो सकती है, भले ही अमेरिका की स्थिति अपरिवर्तित रहे।

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: कोई भी एक कारक मुद्रा की साल भर की हलचल की व्याख्या नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक अक्सर इस बात पर असहमत होते हैं कि कौन से कारक प्रमुख हैं, और पूर्वानुमानों का ट्रैक रिकॉर्ड मिला-जुला रहा है।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## यात्रियों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: विदेश यात्रा करने वाले अमेरिकियों के लिए, एक मजबूत डॉलर का आम तौर पर मतलब अधिक क्रय शक्ति होता है।

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: एक यूरो या येन के लिए कम डॉलर खर्च करने पड़ते हैं, इसलिए खाना, ठहरना और स्मारिकाएँ सस्ती लग सकती हैं।

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: एक कमजोर डॉलर इसके विपरीत काम करता है, जिससे उसी यात्रा की लागत बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक टिप्स:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **केवल मुख्य दर नहीं, बल्कि कुल लागत की तुलना करें।** कार्ड शुल्क, एटीएम शुल्क और हवाई अड्डे के विनिमय कियोस्क एक अनुकूल विनिमय दर के लाभ को समाप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **स्थानीय मुद्रा में भुगतान करें।** जब कार्ड टर्मिनल आपको डॉलर में चार्ज करने का विकल्प देता है, तो रूपांतरण दर अक्सर कम अनुकूल होती है। स्थानीय मुद्रा चुनना आमतौर पर सस्ता पड़ता है।

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **बिना विदेशी लेनदेन शुल्क वाले कार्डों पर विचार करें।** ये शुल्क आमतौर पर कुछ कार्डों पर लगभग 3 प्रतिशत होते हैं, जो एक लंबी यात्रा के दौरान काफी बढ़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **सुविधानुसार बड़ी वस्तुओं के लिए अग्रिम भुगतान करें।** डॉलर में होटल या टूर मूल्य तय करने से विनिमय-दर का अनिश्चित अनुमान हट जाता है, हालांकि यह लचीलेपन को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका आने वाले आगंतुकों के लिए, इसके विपरीत लागू होता है: एक मजबूत डॉलर अमेरिकी यात्राओं को अधिक महंगा बनाता है, जो पर्यटन पर निर्भर व्यवसायों और गंतव्यों को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## निर्यातकों और आयातकों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: एक मजबूत डॉलर अमेरिकी

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: सामानों को विदेशी खरीदारों के लिए अधिक महंगा बनाता है, जिससे निर्यात बिक्री पर असर पड़ सकता है जब तक कि कंपनियां कीमतें कम न करें और कम मार्जिन स्वीकार न करें।

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué mueve al dólar?

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: Los tipos de cambio reflejan el atractivo relativo de una moneda frente a otra.

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: Un puñado de fuerzas suelen ser las más importantes:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **Expectativas de tipos de interés.** Cuando los inversores esperan que los tipos de interés en EE. UU. se mantengan más altos que los de otras grandes economías, los activos denominados en dólares se vuelven más atractivos y la demanda de la moneda puede aumentar. Cuando la brecha se estrecha, puede ocurrir lo contrario.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **Crecimiento económico y datos.** Unas lecturas sólidas de empleo, gasto e inflación en EE. UU. pueden cambiar las expectativas sobre la política del banco central. Las sorpresas, en cualquier dirección, suelen provocar los movimientos más bruscos.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **Demanda de refugio seguro.** En periodos de incertidumbre global, los inversores suelen trasladar dinero a los bonos del Tesoro de EE. UU., lo que tiende a respaldar al dólar.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **Comercio y política fiscal.** Los anuncios de aranceles, las negociaciones comerciales y los planes de endeudamiento del gobierno pueden influir en cómo los inversores ven la moneda con el tiempo.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Política en otros países.** El dólar siempre cotiza frente a algo. Un cambio de política en el Banco Central Europeo, el Banco de Japón o en otros lugares puede mover el tipo de cambio incluso si las condiciones en EE. UU. no cambian.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: Ningún factor por sí solo explica un año de movimientos de divisas.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: Los analistas a menudo no se ponen de acuerdo sobre cuáles son los dominantes, y las previsiones tienen un historial mixto.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para los viajeros

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: Para los estadounidenses que viajan al extranjero, un dólar más fuerte generalmente significa más poder adquisitivo.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: Un euro o un yen cuestan menos dólares, por定番 lo que las comidas, el alojamiento y los recuerdos pueden parecer más baratos.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: Un dólar más débil funciona al revés, encareciendo el coste del mismo viaje.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: Algunos consejos prácticos:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Compara el coste total, no solo la tasa principal.** Las comisiones de las tarjetas, los cargos de los cajeros automáticos y los quioscos de cambio de los aeropuertos pueden borrar un tipo de cambio favorable.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **Paga en moneda local.** Cuando un terminal de tarjeta ofrece cobrarte en dólares, el tipo de cambio suele ser menos favorable. Elegir la moneda local suele costar menos.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **Considera tarjetas sin comisiones por transacciones en el extranjero.** Estas comisiones suelen rondar el 3 por ciento en algunas tarjetas, lo que puede acumularse en un viaje largo.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **Paga por adelantado los artículos caros cuando te convenga.** Fijar el precio de un hotel o una excursión en dólares elimina las conjeturas sobre el tipo de cambio, aunque puede reducir la flexibilidad.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: Para los visitantes que vienen a Estados Unidos, se aplica lo contrario: un dólar más fuerte hace que los viajes a Estados Unidos sean más caros, lo que puede afectar a las empresas y destinos dependientes del turismo.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **Materias primas.** Muchas materias primas, incluidos el petróleo y el oro, cotizan en dólares. Un dólar más fuerte puede encarecerlas para los compradores que usan otras monedas y, a veces, ejerce una presión a la baja sobre los precios.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يحرك الدولار؟

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: تعكس أسعار الصرف الجاذبية النسبية لعملة مقابل أخرى.

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: هناك مجموعة من القوى التي تميل إلى أن تكون الأكثر أهمية:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **توقعات أسعار الفائدة.** عندما يتوقع المستثمرون أن تظل أسعار الفائدة الأمريكية أعلى من تلك الموجودة في الاقتصادات الكبرى الأخرى، تصبح الأصول المقومة بالدولار أكثر جاذبية، وقد يرتفع الطلب على العملة. وعندما تضيق الفجوة، يمكن أن يحدث العكس.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **النمو الاقتصادي والبيانات.** يمكن لقراءات التوظيف والإنفاق والتضخم القوية في الولايات المتحدة أن تغير التوقعات بشأن سياسة البنك المركزي. وغالباً ما تسبب المفاجآت، في أي من الاتجاهين، التحركات الأكثر حدة.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **الطلب على الملاذ الآمن.** في فترات عدم اليقين العالمي، غالباً ما يقوم المستثمرون بنقل الأموال إلى سندات الخزانة الأمريكية، مما يميل إلى دعم الدولار.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **السياسة التجارية والمالية.** يمكن لإعلانات التعريفات الجمركية والمفاوضات التجارية وخطط الاقتراض الحكومية أن تؤثر جميعها على كيفية نظر المستثمرين إلى العملة بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **السياسة في البلدان الأخرى.** يتم تسعير الدولار دائماً مقابل شيء ما. يمكن أن يؤدي التحول في السياسة في البنك المركزي الأوروبي أو بنك اليابان أو في أي مكان آخر إلى تحريك سعر الصرف حتى لو كانت الظروف الأمريكية دون تغيير.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: لا يوجد عامل واحد يفسر عاماً من تحركات العملة.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يختلف المحللون حول العوامل المهيمنة، وللتوقعات سجل حافل متفاوت.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمسافرين

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأمريكيين الذين يسافرون إلى الخارج، يعني الدولار الأقوى عموماً قوة شرائية أكبر.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: يكلف اليورو أو الين عدداً أقل من الدولارات، لذا يمكن أن تبدو الوجبات والإقامة والهدايا التذكارية أرخص.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: يعمل الدولار الأضعف بطريقة معاكسة، مما يؤدي إلى زيادة تكلفة نفس الرحلة.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: بعض النصائح العملية:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **قارن التكلفة الإجمالية، وليس فقط السعر المعلن.** يمكن لرسوم البطاقات ورسوم أجهزة الصراف الآلي وأكشاك صرف العملات في المطارات أن تمحو سعر الصرف المواتي.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **ادفع بالعملة المحلية.** عندما تعرض عليك محطة البطاقة الدفع بالدولار، غالباً ما يكون سعر التحويل أقل ملاءمة. عادة ما يكون اختيار العملة المحلية أقل تكلفة.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **فكر في استخدام بطاقات بدون رسوم معاملات أجنبية.** عادة ما تصل هذه الرسوم إلى حوالي 3 بالمائة في بعض البطاقات، وهو ما يمكن أن يتراكم خلال رحلة طويلة.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **ادفع مسبقاً للبنود باهظة الثمن عندما يناسبك ذلك.** إن تثبيت سعر الفندق أو الجولة بالدولار يزيل التخمين بشأن سعر الصرف، على الرغم من أنه قد يقلل من المرونة.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للزوار القادمين إلى الولايات المتحدة، ينطبق العكس: الدولار الأقوى يجعل الرحلات الأمريكية أكثر تكلفة، مما قد يؤثر على الشركات والوجهات التي تعتمد على السياحة.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمصدرين والمستوردين

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: يجعل الدولار الأقوى السلع الأمريكية

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: أكثر تكلفة للمشترين الأجانب، مما قد يضغط على مبيعات التصدير ما لم تخفض الشركات الأسعار وتقبل هوامش ربح أقل.

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: يميل الدولار الأضعف إلى مساعدة المصدرين من خلال جعل منتجاتهم أرخص في الخارج.

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: يرى المستوردون الصورة المعاكسة.

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: يقلل الدولار الأقوى من تكلفة السلع والمواد المصنعة في الخارج، مما قد يخفف التكاليف على تجار التجزئة والمصنعين الذين يعتمدون على الواردات.

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: يستفيد المستهلكون أحياناً من خلال أسعار أقل، على الرغم من أن انتقال الأثر يكون غير متساوٍ وغالباً ما يتأخر.

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: هناك أيضاً تأثير محاسبي.

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: تحقق الشركات متعددة الجنسيات الكبيرة إيرادات بعملات عديدة.

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: عند تحويل تلك الأرباح الأجنبية مرة أخرى إلى دولارات، يؤدي الدولار الأقوى إلى تقليص الإجمالي المعلن، ويؤدي الدولار الأضعف إلى تضخيمه.

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تناقش الشركات هذا في تقارير الأرباح كـ "رياح معاكسة للعملة" أو "رياح مواتية"، ويستخدم الكثير منها عقود التحوط لتخفيف التأثير.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا لمحفظتك الاستثمارية

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: تعتبر تحركات العملة مهمة لأي شخص يمتلك استثمارات دولية، بما في ذلك الصناديق الواسعة في خطة تقاعد العمل.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **الأسهم والسندات الدولية.** إذا كنت تمتلك أصولاً مسعرة باليورو أو الين أو عملات أخرى، فإن قيمتها بالدولار تعتمد على أداء الأصل وسعر الصرف. يمكن للدولار الصاعد أن يقلل من عوائد الحيازات الأجنبية، بينما يمكن للدولار الهابط أن يعززها.

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **الشركات الأمريكية متعددة الجنسيات.** يمكن للشركات التي تجني الكثير من إيراداتها في الخارج أن ترى أرباحها تتأرجح مع الدولار، كما هو موضح أعلاه.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **السلع.** يتم تسعير العديد من السلع، بما في ذلك النفط والذهب، بالدولار. يمكن للدولار الأقوى أن يجعلها أكثر تكلفة للمشترين الذين يستخدمون عملات أخرى، وأحياناً يضع ضغطاً هبوطياً على الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **الصناديق المحوطة مقابل غير المحوطة.** تستخدم بعض الصناديق عقوداً لتقليل تأثيرات العملة. يمكن أن تكون هذه أكثر تكلفة وقد تتصرف بشكل مختلف عن الإصدارات غير المحوطة، لذا يجدر قراءة وصف الصندوق.

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: تميل تحركات العملة أيضاً إلى الانعكاس والانعكاس مرة أخرى بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: يركز العديد من المستثمرين على المدى الطويل على التنويع وأفقهم الزمني بدلاً من محاولة التنبؤ بالتحول التالي في سعر الصرف.

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: إذا كنت غير متأكد من كيفية تعرض حيازاتك للمخاطر، يمكن لمتخصص مالي مرخص مساعدتك في مراجعتها.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les voyageurs

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: Pour les Américains voyageant à l'étranger, un dollar plus fort signifie généralement un plus grand pouvoir d'achat.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: Un euro ou un yen coûte moins de dollars, de sorte que les repas, l'hébergement et les souvenirs peuvent sembler moins chers.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus faible produit l'effet inverse, augmentant le coût du même voyage.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: Quelques conseils pratiques :

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Comparez le coût total, pas seulement le taux de change affiché.** Les frais de carte, les frais de distributeur automatique et les bureaux de change des aéroports peuvent effacer un taux de change favorable.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **Payez en monnaie locale.** Lorsqu'un terminal de paiement vous propose d'être débité en dollars, le taux de conversion est souvent moins avantageux. Choisir la monnaie locale coûte généralement moins cher.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **Envisagez des cartes sans frais de transaction à l'étranger.** Ces frais tournent généralement autour de 3 % sur certaines cartes, ce qui peut s'accumuler au cours d'un long voyage.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **Prépayez les dépenses importantes lorsque cela vous convient.** Fixer le prix d'un hôtel ou d'une visite en dollars élimine les incertitudes liées au taux de change, bien que cela puisse réduire la flexibilité.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: Pour les visiteurs venant aux États-Unis, c'est l'inverse : un dollar plus fort rend les voyages américains plus chers, ce qui peut affecter les entreprises et les destinations dépendantes du tourisme.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les exportateurs et les importateurs

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus fort rend les produits américains

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: plus chers pour les acheteurs étrangers, ce qui peut peser sur les ventes à l'exportation à moins que les entreprises ne baissent leurs prix et n'acceptent des marges plus faibles.

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus faible a tendance à aider les exportateurs en rendant leurs produits moins chers à l'étranger.

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: Les importateurs constatent le miroir inversé.

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus fort réduit le coût des marchandises et des matériaux fabriqués à l'étranger, ce qui peut alléger les coûts pour les détaillants et les fabricants qui dépendent des importations.

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: Les consommateurs en bénéficient parfois par des prix plus bas, bien que la transmission soit inégale et souvent retardée.

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi un effet comptable.

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: Les grandes entreprises multinationales réalisent des revenus dans de nombreuses devises.

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: Lorsque ces gains étrangers sont reconvertis en dollars, un dollar plus fort réduit le total déclaré, et un dollar plus faible l'amplifie.

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: Les entreprises en discutent souvent dans leurs rapports de résultats comme d'un « vent contraire » ou d'un « vent favorable » lié aux devises, et beaucoup utilisent des contrats de couverture pour atténuer l'impact.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour votre portefeuille

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: Les mouvements de change comptent pour quiconque détient des investissements internationaux, y compris des fonds larges dans un plan d'épargne-retraite d'entreprise.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **Actions et obligations internationales.** Si vous détenez des actifs évalués en euros, en yens ou dans d'autres devises, leur valeur en dollars dépend à la fois de la performance de l'actif et du taux de change. Une hausse du dollar peut réduire les rendements des avoirs étrangers, tandis qu'une baisse du dollar peut les stimuler.

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **Multinationale américaines.** Les entreprises qui tirent une grande partie de leurs revenus de l'étranger peuvent voir leurs profits osciller avec le dollar, comme décrit ci-dessus.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **Matières premières.** De nombreuses matières premières, notamment le pétrole et l'or, sont cotées en dollars. Un dollar plus fort peut les rendre plus chères pour les acheteurs utilisant d'autres devises et exerce parfois une pression à la baisse sur les prix.

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **Fonds couverts par rapport aux fonds non couverts.** Certains fonds utilisent des contrats pour réduire les effets de change. Ceux-ci peuvent coûter plus cher et se comporter différemment des versions non couvertes, il est donc utile de lire la description d'un fonds.

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: Les mouvements de change ont également tendance à s'inverser et à se réinverser au fil du temps.

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: De nombreux investisseurs à long terme se concentrent sur la diversification et leur horizon temporel plutôt que d'essayer de prédire le prochain changement du taux de change.

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: Si vous ne savez pas comment vos avoirs sont exposés, un professionnel de la finance agréé peut vous aider à les examiner.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: Um punhado de forças tende a importar mais:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.

Quando a lacuna diminui, o oposto pode acontecer.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **Economic growth and data.** Leituras fortes de emprego, gastos e inflação nos EUA podem alterar as expectativas sobre a política do banco central. Surpresas, em qualquer direção, muitas vezes causam os movimentos mais acentuados.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **Safe-haven demand.** Em períodos de incerteza global, os investidores frequentemente transferem dinheiro para títulos do Tesouro dos EUA, o que tende a sustentar o dólar.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Anúncios de tarifas, negociações comerciais e planos de empréstimo do governo podem influenciar a forma como os investidores veem a moeda ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Policy in other countries.** O dólar é sempre cotado em relação a algo. Uma mudança na política do Banco Central Europeu, do Banco do Japão ou de outro lugar pode mover a taxa de câmbio mesmo que as condições dos EUA permaneçam inalteradas.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: Nenhum fator isolado explica um ano de movimentos cambiais.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **Pertumbuhan ekonomi dan data.** Data ketenagakerjaan, pengeluaran, dan inflasi AS yang kuat dapat mengubah ekspektasi mengenai kebijakan bank sentral. Kejutan, ke arah mana pun, sering kali menyebabkan pergerakan paling tajam.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan safe-haven.** Dalam periode ketidakpastian global, investor sering kali memindahkan uang ke Surat Berharga Negara AS (U.S. Treasuries), yang cenderung mendukung dolar.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **Kebijakan perdagangan dan fiskal.** Pengumuman tarif, negosiasi perdagangan, dan rencana pinjaman pemerintah semuanya dapat memengaruhi pandangan investor terhadap mata uang tersebut dari waktu ke waktu.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Kebijakan di negara lain.** Dolar selalu dikutip terhadap sesuatu. Perubahan kebijakan di Bank Sentral Eropa, Bank Sentral Jepang, atau di tempat lain dapat menggerakkan nilai tukar meskipun kondisi AS tidak berubah.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu faktor pun yang menjelaskan pergerakan mata uang selama setahun.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: Analis sering kali tidak sepakat mengenai faktor mana yang dominan, dan prakiraan memiliki rekam jejak yang beragam.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Wisatawan

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: Bagi orang Amerika yang bepergian ke luar negeri, dolar yang lebih kuat umumnya berarti daya beli yang lebih besar.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: Satu euro atau satu yen membutuhkan lebih sedikit dolar, sehingga makanan, penginapan, dan suvenir bisa terasa lebih murah.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: Dolar yang lebih lemah bekerja sebaliknya, sedikit menaikkan biaya perjalanan yang sama.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: Beberapa tips praktis:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Bandingkan total biaya, bukan hanya nilai tukar utama.** Biaya kartu, biaya ATM, dan kios penukaran mata uang di bandara dapat menghapus nilai tukar yang menguntungkan.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **Bayar dalam mata uang lokal.** Ketika terminal kartu menawarkan untuk menagih Anda dalam dolar, nilai konversinya sering kali kurang menguntungkan. Memilih mata uang lokal biasanya memakan biaya lebih sedikit.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **Pertimbangkan kartu tanpa biaya transaksi luar negeri.** Biaya ini biasanya sekitar 3 persen pada beberapa kartu, yang bisa bertambah selama perjalanan panjang.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **Bayar di muka untuk barang-barang mahal jika sesuai untuk Anda.** Mengunci harga hotel atau tur dalam dolar menghilangkan tebak-tebakan nilai tukar, meskipun hal itu mungkin mengurangi fleksibilitas.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: Bagi pengunjung yang datang ke Amerika Serikat, hal sebaliknya berlaku: dolar yang lebih kuat membuat perjalanan ke Amerika lebih mahal, yang dapat memengaruhi bisnis dan destinasi yang bergantung pada pariwisata.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Eksportir dan Importir

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: Dolar yang lebih kuat membuat barang

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: AS lebih mahal bagi pembeli asing, yang dapat membebani penjualan ekspor kecuali perusahaan memangkas harga dan menerima margin yang lebih tipis.

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: Dolar yang lebih lemah cenderung membantu eksportir dengan membuat produk mereka lebih murah di luar negeri.

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: Importir melihat kebalikannya.

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: Dolar yang lebih kuat menurunkan biaya barang dan bahan baku buatan luar negeri, yang dapat meringankan biaya bagi pengecer dan produsen yang bergantung pada impor.

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: Konsumen terkadang diuntungkan melalui harga yang lebih rendah, meskipun dampaknya tidak merata dan sering kali tertunda.

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: Ada juga efek akuntansi.

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: Perusahaan multinasional besar memperoleh pendapatan dalam banyak mata uang.

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: Ketika pendapatan luar negeri tersebut dikonversi kembali menjadi dolar, dolar yang lebih kuat menyusutkan total yang dilaporkan, dan dolar yang lebih lemah meningkatkannya.

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: Perusahaan sering membahas hal ini dalam laporan pendapatan sebagai "hambatan mata uang" atau "pendorong," dan banyak yang menggunakan kontrak lindung nilai untuk meredam dampaknya.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Portofolio Anda

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: Pergerakan mata uang penting bagi siapa saja yang memiliki investasi internasional, termasuk dana luas dalam rencana pensiun di tempat kerja.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **Saham dan obligasi internasional.** Jika Anda memegang aset yang dihargai dalam euro, yen, atau mata uang lainnya, nilainya dalam dolar bergantung pada kinerja aset tersebut dan nilai tukar. Dolar yang naik dapat mengurangi imbal hasil pada kepemilikan asing, sementara dolar yang turun dapat meningkatkannya.

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **Perusahaan multinasional AS.** Perusahaan yang memperoleh sebagian besar pendapatannya di luar negeri dapat melihat keuntungan berayun bersama dolar, seperti yang dijelaskan di atas.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **Komoditas.** Banyak komoditas, termasuk minyak dan emas, dihargai dalam dolar. Dolar yang lebih kuat dapat membuatnya lebih mahal bagi pembeli yang menggunakan mata uang lain dan terkadang memberikan tekanan ke bawah pada harga.

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **Dana lindung nilai versus tanpa lindung nilai.** Beberapa dana menggunakan kontrak untuk mengurangi efek mata uang. Ini bisa memakan biaya lebih banyak dan mungkin berperilaku berbeda dari versi tanpa lindung nilai, jadi ada baiknya membaca deskripsi dana tersebut.

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: Pergerakan mata uang juga cenderung berbalik dan berbalik kembali seiring waktu.

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: Banyak investor jangka panjang fokus pada diversifikasi dan cakrawala waktu mereka daripada mencoba memprediksi pergeseran nilai tukar berikutnya.

segments.src: If you are unsure how your holdings are exposed, a licensed financial professional can help you review them.
segments.tr: Jika Anda tidak yakin bagaimana kepemilikan Anda terpapar, profesional keuangan berlisensi dapat membantu Anda meninjaunya.

segments.tr: ## Pemenang dan Pecundang Sekilas

segments.tr: | | Dolar lebih kuat | Dolar lebih lemah |

segments.tr: | Wisatawan AS di luar negeri | Mendapat daya beli | Menghadapi biaya lebih tinggi |

segments.tr: | Pengunjung asing ke AS | Menghadapi biaya lebih tinggi | Mendapat daya beli |

segments.tr: | Eksportir AS | Sering tertekan | Sering terbantu |

segments.src: These are general tendencies, not guarantees.
segments.tr: Ini adalah kecenderungan umum, bukan jaminan.

segments.src: Real-world outcomes depend on pricing power, contracts, hedging and timing.
segments.tr: Hasil dunia nyata bergantung pada kekuatan penetapan harga, kontrak, lindung nilai, dan waktu.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The dollar's value is a moving piece in the economy that touches nearly everyone, whether or not they ever exchange a single bill.
segments.tr: Nilai dolar adalah bagian yang bergerak dalam ekonomi yang menyentuh hampir semua orang, terlepas dari apakah mereka pernah menukarkan satu lembar uang atau tidak.

segments.src: Travelers can protect their budgets by watching fees and exchange rates, businesses can plan around currency risk, and investors can understand how much of their portfolio depends on foreign currencies.
segments.tr: Wisatawan dapat melindungi anggaran mereka dengan memperhatikan biaya dan nilai tukar, bisnis dapat merencanakan risiko mata uang, dan investor dapat memahami seberapa besar portofolio mereka bergantung pada mata uang asing.

segments.src: Staying informed, and keeping a long-term view, is usually more useful than reacting to each day's headline.
segments.tr: Tetap terinformasi, dan menjaga pandangan jangka panjang, biasanya lebih berguna daripada bereaksi terhadap berita utama setiap hari.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?

segments.tr: 為替レートは、ある通貨の別の通貨に対する相対的な魅力を反映しています。

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: いくつかの要因が特に重要になる傾向があります：

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **金利の予想。** 投資家が米国の金利が他の主要経済国よりも高く留まると予想する場合、ドル建て資産の魅力が増し、通貨需要が高まる可能性があります。その差が縮まると、逆のことが起こり得ます。

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **貿易および財政政策。** 関税の発表、貿易交渉、政府の借入計画などはすべて、投資家が時間の経過とともに通貨をどのように見なすかに影響を与えます。

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **他国の政策。** ドルは常に何らかの通貨に対して取引されます。欧州中央銀行（ECB）、日本銀行、あるいはその他の国々における政策の転換は、米国の状況が不変であっても、為替レートを動かす可能性があります。

segments.tr: いくつかの実践的なヒント：

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.

segments.src: ## What Moves the Dollar?
segments.tr: ## Was bewegt den Dollar?

segments.src: Exchange rates reflect the relative appeal of one currency against another.
segments.tr: Wechselkurse spiegeln die relative Attraktivität einer Währung gegenüber einer anderen wider.

segments.src: A handful of forces tend to matter most:
segments.tr: Einige wenige Kräfte sind dabei meist am wichtigsten:

segments.src: - **Interest rate expectations.** When investors expect U.S. interest rates to stay higher than those in other major economies, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, and demand for the currency can rise. When the gap narrows, the opposite can happen.
segments.tr: - **Zinserwartungen.** Wenn Anleger erwarten, dass die US-Zinsen höher bleiben als in anderen großen Volkswirtschaften, werden auf Dollar lautende Vermögenswerte attraktiver und die Nachfrage nach der Währung kann steigen. Wenn sich die Kluft verringert, kann das Gegenteil eintreten.

segments.src: - **Economic growth and data.** Strong U.S. employment, spending and inflation readings can shift expectations about central bank policy. Surprises, in either direction, often cause the sharpest moves.
segments.tr: - **Wirtschaftswachstum und Daten.** Starke US-Beschäftigungs-, Ausgaben- und Inflationsdaten können die Erwartungen an die Zentralbankpolitik verändern. Überraschungen in beide Richtungen führen oft zu den stärksten Bewegungen.

segments.src: - **Safe-haven demand.** In periods of global uncertainty, investors have often moved money into U.S. Treasuries, which tends to support the dollar.
segments.tr: - **Nachfrage nach sicheren Häfen.** In Zeiten globaler Unsicherheit haben Anleger oft Geld in US-Staatsanleihen umgeschichtet, was den Dollar tendenziell stützt.

segments.src: - **Trade and fiscal policy.** Tariff announcements, trade negotiations and government borrowing plans can all influence how investors view the currency over time.
segments.tr: - **Handels- und Fiskalpolitik.** Ankündigungen von Zöllen, Handelsverhandlungen und staatliche Kreditaufnahmepläne können beeinflussen, wie Anleger die Währung im Laufe der Zeit bewerten.

segments.src: - **Policy in other countries.** The dollar is always quoted against something. A shift in policy at the European Central Bank, the Bank of Japan or elsewhere can move the exchange rate even if U.S. conditions are unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Politik in anderen Ländern.** Der Dollar wird immer gegenüber etwas anderem notiert. Eine politische Änderung bei der Europäischen Zentralbank, der Bank of Japan oder anderswo kann den Wechselkurs bewegen, selbst wenn die Bedingungen in den USA unverändert bleiben.

segments.src: No single factor explains a year of currency moves.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Faktor erklärt ein Jahr voller Währungsbewegungen.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which ones are dominant, and forecasts have a mixed track record.
segments.tr: Analysten sind sich oft uneinig darüber, welche Faktoren dominieren, und Prognosen haben eine gemischte Erfolgsbilanz.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Travelers
segments.tr: ## Was bedeutet das für Reisende

segments.src: For Americans traveling abroad, a stronger dollar generally means more purchasing power.
segments.tr: Für Amerikaner, die ins Ausland reisen, bedeutet ein stärkerer Dollar im Allgemeinen mehr Kaufkraft.

segments.src: A euro or a yen costs fewer dollars, so meals, lodging and souvenirs can feel cheaper.
segments.tr: Ein Euro oder ein Yen kostet weniger Dollar, daher können Mahlzeiten, Unterkunft und Souvenirs günstiger erscheinen.

segments.src: A weaker dollar works the other way, nudging up the cost of the same trip.
segments.tr: Ein schwächerer Dollar wirkt sich umgekehrt aus und erhöht die Kosten für dieselbe Reise.

segments.src: A few practical tips:
segments.tr: Ein paar praktische Tipps:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the total cost, not just the headline rate.** Card fees, ATM charges and airport exchange kiosks can erase a favorable exchange rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Vergleichen Sie die Gesamtkosten, nicht nur den angegebenen Kurs.** Kartengebühren, Geldautomatengebühren und Wechselstuben an Flughäfen können einen günstigen Wechselkurs zunichtemachen.

segments.src: 2. **Pay in local currency.** When a card terminal offers to charge you in dollars, the conversion rate is often less favorable. Choosing the local currency usually costs less.
segments.tr: 2. **Zahlen Sie in der Landeswährung.** Wenn ein Kartenterminal anbietet, in Dollar abzurechnen, ist der Umrechnungskurs oft weniger günstig. Die Wahl der Landeswährung kostet in der Regel weniger.

segments.src: 3. **Consider cards without foreign transaction fees.** These fees commonly run around 3 percent on some cards, which can add up over a long trip.
segments.tr: 3. **Erwägen Sie Karten ohne Fremdwährungsgebühren.** Diese Gebühren liegen bei einigen Karten oft bei etwa 3 Prozent, was sich auf einer langen Reise summieren kann.

segments.src: 4. **Prepay big-ticket items when it suits you.** Locking in a hotel or tour price in dollars removes the exchange-rate guesswork, though it may reduce flexibility.
segments.tr: 4. **Bezahlen Sie teure Posten im Voraus, wenn es Ihnen passt.** Die Festlegung eines Hotel- oder Reisepreises in Dollar beseitigt das Rätselraten beim Wechselkurs, auch wenn dies die Flexibilität verringern kann.

segments.src: For visitors coming to the United States, the reverse applies: a stronger dollar makes American trips more expensive, which can affect tourism-dependent businesses and destinations.
segments.tr: Für Besucher, die in die Vereinigten Staaten kommen, gilt das Umgekehrte: Ein stärkerer Dollar macht US-Reisen teurer, was sich auf tourismusabhängige Unternehmen und Reiseziele auswirken kann.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Exporters and Importers
segments.tr: ## Was bedeutet das für Exporteure und Importeure

segments.src: A stronger dollar makes U.S.
segments.tr: Ein stärkerer Dollar macht US-

segments.src: goods more expensive for foreign buyers, which can weigh on export sales unless companies cut prices and accept thinner margins.
segments.tr: Waren für ausländische Käufer teurer, was die Exportumsätze belasten kann, es sei denn, Unternehmen senken die Preise und akzeptieren geringere Margen.

segments.src: A weaker dollar tends to help exporters by making their products cheaper abroad.
segments.tr: Ein schwächerer Dollar hilft Exporteuren tendenziell, indem er ihre Produkte im Ausland billiger macht.

segments.src: Importers see the mirror image.
segments.tr: Importeure sehen das Spiegelbild.

segments.src: A stronger dollar lowers the cost of foreign-made goods and materials, which can ease costs for retailers and manufacturers that rely on imports.
segments.tr: Ein stärkerer Dollar senkt die Kosten für ausländische Waren und Materialien, was Einzelhändlern und Herstellern, die auf Importe angewiesen sind, die Kosten erleichtern kann.

segments.src: Consumers sometimes benefit through lower prices, though pass-through is uneven and often delayed.
segments.tr: Verbraucher profitieren manchmal durch niedrigere Preise, obwohl die Weitergabe ungleichmäßig und oft verzögert erfolgt.

segments.src: There is also an accounting effect.
segments.tr: Es gibt auch einen buchhalterischen Effekt.

segments.src: Large multinational companies earn revenue in many currencies.
segments.tr: Große multinationale Unternehmen erzielen Umsätze in vielen Währungen.

segments.src: When those foreign earnings are converted back into dollars, a stronger dollar shrinks the reported total, and a weaker dollar inflates it.
segments.tr: Wenn diese Auslandseinnahmen wieder in Dollar umgerechnet werden, verringert ein stärkerer Dollar die ausgewiesene Gesamtsumme, und ein schwächerer Dollar bläht sie auf.

segments.src: Companies often discuss this in earnings reports as a "currency headwind" or "tailwind," and many use hedging contracts to soften the impact.
segments.tr: Unternehmen diskutieren dies in Ergebnisberichten oft als "Währungsgegenwind" oder "Rückenwind", und viele nutzen Absicherungsgeschäfte, um die Auswirkungen abzufedern.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Portfolio
segments.tr: ## Was bedeutet das für Ihr Portfolio

segments.src: Currency movements matter for anyone who owns international investments, including broad funds in a workplace retirement plan.
segments.tr: Währungsbewegungen sind für jeden wichtig, der internationale Investitionen besitzt, einschließlich breit gestreuter Fonds in einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

segments.src: - **International stocks and bonds.** If you hold assets priced in euros, yen or other currencies, their value in dollars depends on both the asset's performance and the exchange rate. A rising dollar can reduce returns on foreign holdings, while a falling dollar can boost them.
segments.tr: - **Internationale Aktien und Anleihen.** Wenn Sie Vermögenswerte halten, die in Euro, Yen oder anderen Währungen notiert sind, hängt ihr Wert in Dollar sowohl von der Wertentwicklung des Vermögenswerts als auch vom Wechselkurs ab. Ein steigender Dollar kann die Rendite ausländischer Bestände verringern, während ein fallender Dollar sie steigern kann.

segments.src: - **U.S. multinationals.** Companies that earn much of their revenue overseas can see profits swing with the dollar, as described above.
segments.tr: - **US-Multis.** Unternehmen, die einen Großteil ihres Umsatzes im Ausland erzielen, können Gewinnschwankungen mit dem Dollar erleben, wie oben beschrieben.

segments.src: - **Commodities.** Many commodities, including oil and gold, are priced in dollars. A stronger dollar can make them more expensive for buyers using other currencies and sometimes puts downward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: - **Rohstoffe.** Viele Rohstoffe, einschließlich Öl und Gold, werden in Dollar gehandelt. Ein stärkerer Dollar kann sie für Käufer, die andere Währungen verwenden, teurer machen und übt manchmal Abwärtsdruck auf die Preise aus.

segments.src: - **Hedged versus unhedged funds.** Some funds use contracts to reduce currency effects. These can cost more and may behave differently from unhedged versions, so it is worth reading a fund's description.
segments.tr: - **Abgesicherte versus nicht abgesicherte Fonds.** Einige Fonds verwenden Verträge, um Währungseffekte zu reduzieren. Diese können mehr kosten und sich anders verhalten als nicht abgesicherte Versionen, daher lohnt es sich, die Fondsbeschreibung zu lesen.

segments.src: Currency moves also tend to reverse and re-reverse over time.
segments.tr: Währungsbewegungen kehren sich im Laufe der Zeit auch tendenziell um und wieder um.

segments.src: Many long-term investors focus on diversification and their time horizon rather than trying to predict the next shift in the exchange rate.
segments.tr: Viele langfristige Anleger konzentrieren sich auf Diversifizierung und ihren Zeithorizont, anstatt zu versuchen, die nächste Verschiebung des Wechselkurses vorherzusagen.
